note: Luce County Parks & Rec park on North Manistique Lake at 3266 CR-478, McMillan; swimming beach, boat launch. Mix of first-come sites ($19) and online-reservable sites ($34); the county's own page posts no camping rate. Accepts big rigs. --Claude
summary: County Parks & Rec page: 45 back-in sites with 30/50-amp electric and water, showers ($5), dump station ($10), open Memorial Day through October weather permitting, online reservations 'www.camplife.com'. Hookups/sites/dump now manual; added showers and the season statement. No camping rate on the county page (the note's $19 / $34 are unsourced; fees stay empty). The county's CampLife link finds no campground and CampLife lists none near Newberry, so the reservation path could not be confirmed (booking left as derived). Note cleaned of the hookup/site/season text.
